1.web: A good name is more desirable than great riches, and loving favor is better than silver and gold.
1.asv: Agoodname is rather to be chosen than great riches, And loving favor rather than silver and gold.

2.web: The rich and the poor have this in common: Yahweh is the maker of them all.
2.asv: The rich and the poor meet together: Jehovah is the maker of them all.

3.web: A prudent man sees danger, and hides himself; but the simple pass on, and suffer for it.
3.asv: A prudent man seeth the evil, and hideth himself; But the simple pass on, and suffer for it.

4.web: The result of humility and the fear of Yahweh is wealth, honor, and life.
4.asv: The reward of humility and the fear of Jehovah Isriches, and honor, and life.

5.web: Thorns and snares are in the path of the wicked: whoever guards his soul stays from them.
5.asv: Thornsandsnares are in the way of the perverse: He that keepeth his soul shall be far from them.

6.web: Train up a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not depart from it.
6.asv: Train up a child in the way he should go, And even when he is old he will not depart from it.

7.web: The rich rule over the poor. The borrower is servant to the lender.
7.asv: The rich ruleth over the poor; And the borrower is servant to the lender.

8.web: He who sows wickedness reaps trouble, and the rod of his fury will be destroyed.
8.asv: He that soweth iniquity shall reap calamity; And the rod of his wrath shall fail.

9.web: He who has a generous eye will be blessed; for he shares his food with the poor.
9.asv: He that hath a bountiful eye shall be blessed; For he giveth of his bread to the poor.

10.web: Drive out the mocker, and strife will go out; yes, quarrels and insults will stop.
10.asv: Cast out the scoffer, and contention will go out; Yea, strife and ignominy will cease.

11.web: He who loves purity of heart and speaks gracefully is the king’s friend.
11.asv: He that loveth pureness of heart, Forthe grace of his lips the king will be his friend.

12.web: The eyes of Yahweh watch over knowledge; but he frustrates the words of the unfaithful.
12.asv: The eyes of Jehovah preservehim that hathknowledge; But he overthroweth the words of the treacherous man.

13.web: The sluggard says, “There is a lion outside! I will be killed in the streets!”
13.asv: The sluggard saith, There is a lion without; I shall be slain in the streets.

14.web: The mouth of an adulteress is a deep pit: he who is under Yahweh’s wrath will fall into it.
14.asv: The mouth of strange women is a deep pit; He that is abhorred of Jehovah shall fall therein.

15.web: Folly is bound up in the heart of a child: the rod of discipline drives it far from him.
15.asv: Foolishness is bound up in the heart of a child; Butthe rod of correction shall drive it far from him.

16.web: Whoever oppresses the poor for his own increase and whoever gives to the rich, both come to poverty.
16.asv: He that oppresseth the poor to increase his gain, Andhe that giveth to the rich, shall come only to want.

17.web: Turn your ear, and listen to the words of the wise. Apply your heart to my teaching.
17.asv: Incline thine ear, and hear the words of the wise, And apply thy heart unto my knowledge.

18.web: For it is a pleasant thing if you keep them within you, if all of them are ready on your lips.
18.asv: For it is a pleasant thing if thou keep them within thee, If they be established together upon thy lips.

19.web: That your trust may be in Yahweh, I teach you today, even you.
19.asv: That thy trust may be in Jehovah, I have madethemknown to thee this day, even to thee.

20.web: Haven’t I written to you thirty excellent things of counsel and knowledge,
20.asv: Have not I written unto thee excellent things Of counsels and knowledge,

21.web: To teach you truth, reliable words, to give sound answers to the ones who sent you?
21.asv: To make thee know the certainty of the words of truth, That thou mayest carry back words of truth to them that send thee?

22.web: Don’t exploit the poor, because he is poor; and don’t crush the needy in court;
22.asv: Rob not the poor, because he is poor; Neither oppress the afflicted in the gate:

23.web: for Yahweh will plead their case, and plunder the life of those who plunder them.
23.asv: For Jehovah will plead their cause, And despoil of life those that despoil them.

24.web: Don’t befriend a hot-tempered man, and don’t associate with one who harbors anger:
24.asv: Make no friendship with a man that is given to anger; And with a wrathful man thou shalt not go:

25.web: lest you learn his ways, and ensnare your soul.
25.asv: Lest thou learn his ways, And get a snare to thy soul.

26.web: Don’t you be one of those who strike hands, of those who are collateral for debts.
26.asv: Be thou not one of them that strike hands, Orof them that are sureties for debts.

27.web: If you don’t have means to pay, why should he take away your bed from under you?
27.asv: If thou hast not wherewith to pay, Why should he take away thy bed from under thee?

28.web: Don’t move the ancient boundary stone, which your fathers have set up.
28.asv: Remove not the ancient landmark, Which thy fathers have set.

29.web: Do you see a man skilled in his work? He will serve kings. He won’t serve obscure men.
29.asv: Seest thou a man diligent in his business? he shall stand before kings; He shall not stand before mean men.
